name: folk-stitch
vibe: an embroidered folk sampler sewn in real time on midnight felt: bright marigold, red and teal thread on dark fabric, slab-serif letters punched up one by one like needle stitches, a sampler border that sews itself around every frame, running stitches crawling as the thread pulls through, scene changes as a loom shuttle of bold stripes — for artisan brands, handmade goods, cozy storytelling and anything that should feel crafted stitch by stitch

assets.photoMod: embroidery folk art textile handmade cross stitch craft

sfx.style: needle punches, thread pulls and scissor snips — a sewing-machine cadence under the letter stitches, a fabric swish on each weave cut
